raw_evidence: /mnt/project-files/evals-cache/f9-bates/ (ref/ reference outputs, captures and network logs; out/ our outputs, one HAR, Lighthouse JSON and logs; shots/; scripts/). Side-by-side captures: /mnt/project-files/comparisons/f9-bates/. Not in git.
harness: Playwright headless Chromium, 1280x632 and 390x664. Result read by polling the result frame every 25 ms (reference) and by a mutation observer (ours).

flow: Choosing files uploads them at once (an upload check, then the upload; 0.3-0.4 s for these files).
Two files chosen together: the free tier keeps the first and shows a notice that one file per task is allowed without paying. No task was spent on this.

Options: one list of 20 preset lines (3 line shapes x 5 number widths of 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 digits, plus number only x 5) and a custom line with file-number and running-number tokens; the label words of a preset can be edited; 6 positions; start of the running number; start of the file counter; margins left alone or increased; 3 fonts; 18 sizes from 6 to 60; a colour picker; a pattern for the result's file name. Font, size, colour and name sit behind a 'more options' link.
The preview is three sample lines of text; it refreshes on a key press, not when a value is set otherwise.
Stated free limits on this page: 200 pages or 50 MB, 3 tasks an hour.
Result opens in an overlay frame.
